main.p: Guia publica completa para integrar pagos con autenticacion HMAC, provider obligatorio y flujo de retorno configurable.

section.div: Flujo minimo: generar firma HMAC -> enviar POST /api/v1/payments/intents con provider -> guardar order_id -> consultar estado o procesar webhook.

pre.code: curl -X POST "https://TU-DOMINIO/api/v1/payments/intents" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -H "X-Client-Id: TU_CLIENT_ID" \ -H "X-Timestamp: 1716200000" \ -H "X-Nonce: 8f6de1b6-1a3b-4f03-b8d4-0f2f5b88e200" \ -H "X-Signature: BASE64_HMAC_SHA256" \ -H "Idempotency-Key: 1ef8ca0b-7922-49ac-8fcb-19ac7a56f3d6" \ -d '{ "provider": "depay", "amount": 12000, "currency": "CLP", "external_order_id": "txn_123456", "expires_in": 900, "concept": "Compra API", "qr_from": "AR" }'

section.p: Headers requeridos: X-Client-Id, X-Timestamp, X-Nonce, X-Signature. Para create intent tambien se exige Idempotency-Key.

pre.code:
import base64 import hashlib import hmac from urllib.parse import parse_qsl
def sign_request(method, path, query_string, raw_body, timestamp, nonce, client_secret): pairs = parse_qsl(query_string or "", keep_blank_values=True) pairs.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1])) normalized_query = "&".join([f"{k}={v}" for k, v in pairs])
body_hash = hashlib.sha256((raw_body or "").encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() canonical = "\n".join([method.upper(), path, normalized_query, body_hash, str(timestamp), nonce])
digest = hmac.new(client_secret.encode("utf-8"), canonical.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).digest() return base64.b64encode(digest).decode("utf-8")

<?php
function sign_request($method, $path, $queryString, $rawBody, $timestamp, $nonce, $clientSecret) {
    parse_str($queryString ?: "", $query);
    ksort($query);
    $normalizedQuery = http_build_query($query, "", "&", PHP_QUERY_RFC3986);

    $bodyHash = hash("sha256", $rawBody ?: "");
    $canonical = strtoupper($method) . "\n" . $path . "\n" . $normalizedQuery . "\n" . $bodyHash . "\n" . $timestamp . "\n" . $nonce;

    $hmac = hash_hmac("sha256", $canonical, $clientSecret, true);
    return base64_encode($hmac);
}
?>

import json import requests import time import uuid
def create_intent(base_url, client_id, client_secret): path = "/api/v1/payments/intents" payload = { "provider": "depay", "amount": 12000, "currency": "CLP", "external_order_id": "txn_123456", "expires_in": 900, "concept": "Compra API", "qr_from": "AR", } raw_body = json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":")) ts = str(int(time.time())) nonce = str(uuid.uuid4()) idem = str(uuid.uuid4()) signature = sign_request("POST", path, "", raw_body, ts, nonce, client_secret)
headers = { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Client-Id": client_id, "X-Timestamp": ts, "X-Nonce": nonce, "X-Signature": signature, "Idempotency-Key": idem, } response = requests.post(f"{base_url}{path}", data=raw_body, headers=headers, timeout=20) response.raise_for_status() return response.json()

<?php
$path = "/api/v1/payments/intents";
$payload = json_encode([
    "provider" => "depay",
    "amount" => 12000,
    "currency" => "CLP",
    "external_order_id" => "txn_123456",
    "expires_in" => 900,
    "concept" => "Compra API",
    "qr_from" => "AR"
]);

$timestamp = strval(time());
$nonce = uuid_create(UUID_TYPE_RANDOM);
$idempotency = uuid_create(UUID_TYPE_RANDOM);
$signature = sign_request("POST", $path, "", $payload, $timestamp, $nonce, $clientSecret);

$headers = [
    "Content-Type: application/json",
    "X-Client-Id: $clientId",
    "X-Timestamp: $timestamp",
    "X-Nonce: $nonce",
    "X-Signature: $signature",
    "Idempotency-Key: $idempotency"
];

$ch = curl_init($baseUrl . $path);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, $payload);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
$response = curl_exec($ch);
curl_close($ch);
?>

path := "/api/v1/payments/intents" body := `{"provider":"depay","amount":12000,"currency":"CLP","external_order_id":"txn_123456","expires_in":900,"concept":"Compra API","qr_from":"AR"}` ts := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().Unix(), 10) nonce := uuid.New().String() idem := uuid.New().String() canonical := strings.Join([]string{"POST", path, "", sha256Hex(body), ts, nonce}, "\n") signature := SignRequest(canonical, clientSecret)
req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", baseURL+path, strings.NewReader(body)) req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json") req.Header.Set("X-Client-Id", clientID) req.Header.Set("X-Timestamp", ts) req.Header.Set("X-Nonce", nonce) req.Header.Set("X-Signature", signature) req.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", idem) res, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)

section.p: El cliente API define como cerrar el flujo en el comercio mediante return_url y return_url_behavior.
Cuando uses callback firmado, firma recomendada: HMAC-SHA256 sobre la cadena ordenada status=...&order_id=...&transaction_id=....

ul.li: unsupported_provider: provider fuera de catalogo soportado.
provider_not_configured: sin override ni configuracion global activa.
provider_service_not_available: provider soportado sin servicio implementado.
provider_mismatch_webhook: provider de ruta diferente al intent asociado.
missing_idempotency_key: falta header en create intent.
